The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

room.name: The Hollow Thunderforge: Sump Ladders
room.description: Ladders vanish down a wet shaft. Giant pump chains hang beside them, each link large enough to be a doorframe.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

room.name: The Hollow Thunderforge: Flooded Cistern
room.description: A cold cistern reflects lightning that is not in the room. Water breathing magic would help, but stubbornness and good rope may suffice for a short crossing.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

room.name: The Hollow Thunderforge: Grounding Conduit
room.description: A conduit of black stone, sky-iron, and giant bronze channels lightning toward the mountain roots. Cabal clamps have reversed the flow into a necromantic circuit.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

object.name: Reversed Grounding Clamps
object.description: Cabal clamps force lightning upward through bone wire instead of down into the mountain.
object.interact_text: You drive in the grounding spike and turn the current back toward stone. The forge stops screaming quite so loudly.
object.completed_text: The conduit now bleeds the worst corpse-lightning safely into the mountain roots.
object.missing_item_text: You need a proper grounding spike before touching the clamps will be anything but suicide.

room.name: The Hollow Thunderforge: Corpse-Lightning Coils
room.description: Coils of blackened copper wrap around suspended bones. Each pulse makes the dead miners twitch like puppets remembering work songs.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

room.name: The Hollow Thunderforge: Pitfall Floor
room.description: The floor collapses into a maintenance trench lined with glass teeth. It is not a trap from the original forge; it is Cabal work, cruel and hurried.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

room.name: The Hollow Thunderforge: Hidden Weather Cache
room.description: A hidden weather cache survived behind a false panel. The giant script above it reads: FOR THOSE WHO REPAIR BEFORE THEY CLAIM.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

room.name: The Hollow Thunderforge: Storm-Spirit Pen
room.description: Bound storm spirits circle inside rings of salt, ash, and giant hair. Their voices sound like rain on every roof the player has ever known.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

object.name: Storm-Spirit Binding Seals
object.description: The binding seals are too dangerous while the grounding conduit remains reversed.
object.interact_text: With the conduit repaired, you break the seals. The storm spirits flee upward, leaving clean rain behind.
object.completed_text: The spirit pen is empty except for rainwater and cooling ash.

room.name: The Hollow Thunderforge: Bone Gantry
room.description: A gantry of giant ribs and stolen bridge cable crosses the forge’s inner chasm. Dead miners crawl along it with tools fused to their hands.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

room.name: The Hollow Thunderforge: False Pressure Gallery
room.description: The gallery appears to lead onward, but every pressure plate points back toward the same cracked column. The real reward is in noticing the trap before it notices you.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

room.name: The Hollow Thunderforge: Blackened Dynamo
room.description: The forge heart rotates in the dark, a storm engine forced to beat like a dead thing. Vael Tormak’s ritual circle glows beyond the last arc of bone lightning.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

room.name: The Hollow Thunderforge: Command Circle
room.description: Vael Tormak stands inside a circle of corpse-lightning, conducting dead miners, bound storm spirits, and the forge itself like a choir of unwilling thunder.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

room.name: Thunderheart Aegis Chamber
room.description: The relic chamber is quiet after the forge’s roar. The Thunderheart Aegis rests in a cradle of stormglass, not as a trophy, but as a promise that power must shield before it commands.

companion_dialogue.line: This is not a road so much as a storm deciding whether travelers deserve a path.
The giants are not absent. They are watching from above the thunderline.

object.name: Thunderheart Aegis Pedestal
object.description: A storm-giant wardstone shaped like a shielded heart rests on the pedestal.
object.interact_text: The Aegis accepts your touch only after the forge is freed from the Cabal. Its thunder is protective, not possessive.
object.completed_text: The empty pedestal still hums with clean rain and distant giant song.

room.name: The Blackfall Descent
room.description: The path from Thundervale breaks into a vertical wound in the mountain. Ropes, old pitons, and glowmoss knots descend past stone wet with black mineral tears. The last surface wind dies here.

companion_dialogue.line: Down here, silence does not mean safety. It means the thing listening is patient.
The Depths are not a dungeon. They are a country without a sky.

object.name: Blackfall Warning Glyphs
object.description: Deep gnome warning-glyphs mark safe grips, false ledges, and the words DO NOT DROP LIGHT.
object.interact_text: You copy the descent marks and learn the first Compact law: falling is private, but wasted light is everyone’s problem.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Blackfall Ropewalk
room.description: A suspended ropewalk crosses a chimney of cold air. Far below, scattered lights mark settlements and predators with equal beauty.

companion_dialogue.line: Down here, silence does not mean safety. It means the thing listening is patient.
The Depths are not a dungeon. They are a country without a sky.

room.name: Collapsed Expedition Camp
room.description: Rotten canvas, broken climbing frames, and a brass kettle sit beneath a shelf of stone. Someone tried to keep surface habits alive until the last candle failed.

object.name: Surface Song Scraps
object.description: Torn song pages describe clouds to children who never saw them.
object.interact_text: You gather the pages and the cracked music box. The tune is small, stubborn, and terribly brave.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Dripstone Overlook
room.description: A limestone shelf overlooks hundreds of needle-thin stalagmites. Each drop sounds like a footstep from a different direction.

room.name: Basin of Whispering Water
room.description: A clear basin reflects no faces, only crowns sinking through black water. The Compact marks the pool as sacred and dangerous.

object.name: Water That Whispers Names
object.description: The water whispers names from the lost kingdoms above and below.
object.interact_text: You hear names that should belong to Sunken Crown Marsh, Astral court records, and a few that have not been spoken yet.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Lanternless Threshold
room.description: The first true layer of the Depths opens into low warrens where light fades faster than flame should allow. Scratch marks warn against open shouting.

room.name: Cartographer’s Nook
room.description: Bone slats, chalk lines, hanging plumb weights, and upside-down maps fill a dry alcove. Several arrows have been crossed out and replaced with question marks.

object.name: Bone Compass
object.description: A compass needle made of fingerbone points down, then up, then apologetically sideways.
object.interact_text: You reset the plumb weight and mark a sane route through the warrens.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Lightfall Quarry
room.description: Veins of dim crystal have been gouged from the quarry walls. Empty sockets in the stone show where stolen light-crystals once grew.

object.name: Stolen Crystal Marks
object.description: Iron boot prints and bone-lamp soot lead away from the quarry.
object.interact_text: You recover a sack of stolen light-crystals and identify Cabal handling marks beneath duergar chain scratches.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Ashen Switchback
room.description: A sloping tunnel spirals around old vents stained gray by mineral smoke. The air tastes of forge ash and damp stone.

room.name: Blindstone Warren
room.description: Low passages twist between smooth stones polished by eyeless predators. Every pebble kicked loose becomes an announcement.

room.name: Echo Crack
room.description: A narrow crack splits the warren wall. Voices thrown into it return older, lower, and sometimes in languages the speaker never learned.

object.name: Unreliable Echoes
object.description: Chalk marks show which echoes wake predators and which ones mask movement.
object.interact_text: You mark a few safe sound-lines, enough to move through the crack without calling every hungry thing nearby.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Whispering Pool
room.description: A low pool collects cold water and drifting spores. Ripples form words, then deny having done so.

room.name: Mycelial Rootway
room.description: Thick fungal cords bridge the cavern like pale tree roots. They flex slightly beneath careful steps.

room.name: Stolen Lantern Hollow
room.description: A hollow full of cracked lantern frames and dead wicks marks where raiders sorted stolen light before selling it deeper.

room.name: Outer Gate of Glowcap Commons
room.description: A barricade of mushroom timber, deep iron, and quiet spears blocks the way into the Commons. Lanterns burn behind glass shutters so no light is wasted on strangers.

companion_dialogue.line: Down here, silence does not mean safety. It means the thing listening is patient.
The Depths are not a dungeon. They are a country without a sky.

object.name: Compact Debt-Law Plaque
object.description: A slate plaque lists five laws: do not waste light, do not poison water, do not wake what sleeps below, do not bring surface wars below, and pay debts in kind.
object.interact_text: You read the laws aloud. Several guards relax when you do not laugh.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Compact Watchfire
room.description: A shielded blue fire warms sentries who never face the same tunnel for too long. The guards speak in hand signs to avoid feeding the echoes.

room.name: Spore Toll Stand
room.description: Kobold lantern-keepers weigh wick-salt, oil, and glowcap dust with religious seriousness.

room.name: Glowcap Commons Entry
room.description: The village proper opens under a ceiling of enormous blue and green fungi. Houses are carved into stone columns, mushroom shelves, and old lava tubes patched with deep-iron balconies.
room.locked_message: The guards bar the way. Glowcap Commons proper is closed until you earn a Glowcap Safe-Lantern by returning stolen light to the Compact.

room.name: Safe-Lantern Provisioner
room.description: Rows of lanterns sit in padded nests beside wick-salt, fungus wax, crystal shutters, and warning bells tuned to predators.

room.name: Quiet Bloom Spore-Healing Grotto
room.description: Soft caps glow above stone beds. Patients whisper into fungal cups that drink pain, fever, and occasionally secrets.

room.name: Glowcap Central Bazaar
room.description: Deep gnomes, duergar exiles, kobolds, drow outcasts, and blind surface-folk trade by shuttered light. The smell is iron, mushrooms, old water, and bargaining.

room.name: Bone-Map Archives
room.description: Shelves of rib-slats and shell tablets hang from spider-silk lines. The maps include roads, debts, graves, and places where people stopped coming back.

room.name: Fungus Farmlanes
room.description: Rows of edible caps grow in damp terraces. Children carry shuttered lamps while elders sing timing songs to the spores.

room.name: Grief-Spore Cleft
room.description: Pale fungi grow from stone marked with old names. The air makes memories feel freshly wounded.

room.name: Mycelial Choir Grove
room.description: A circular grove of towering fungi hums with shared memory. Visitors are asked to breathe gently and think honestly.

object.name: Choir Breathing Circle
object.description: A ring of soft spores waits for a visitor willing to share breath without taking memory by force.
object.interact_text: You breathe in the Choir’s rhythm and receive a map that feels like a remembered dream rather than a drawing.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Dreamspore Sanctum
room.description: Fungal curtains divide dream chambers where the Choir processes grief too poisonous to leave raw.

object.name: Dreamspore Rite
object.description: The Choir offers a controlled dream of the Shadowed Ossuary’s outer roads.
object.interact_text: You wake with gray dust on your palms and a remembered route through bones you have not yet seen.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Spore Memory Chamber
room.description: Memory beads hang like dew from threads of pale fungus. Each bead contains one warning someone died to learn.

room.name: Deep Roads Lift
room.description: A crank platform descends into trade tunnels older than the Compact. The lift operator refuses to run it without three witnesses and a paid lamp.

room.name: Gate to the Ashen Exchange
room.description: Iron beads, trade seals, and duergar warning masks hang over a tunnel mouth darkened by old forge smoke.

room.name: Freehammer Deep Forge
room.description: A duergar forge burns with low red heat. Broken collars hang above the anvil where horseshoes might hang in kinder places.

room.name: Drow Exile Gallery
room.description: Stone alcoves hold lenses, inverted star charts, and paintings of a sky the exiles debate with academic cruelty.

room.name: Ashen Exchange Market
room.description: The market trades in metal, food, secrets, bone, and silence. Someone has been buying far too much of the last three.

room.name: Debt-Token Den
room.description: Judges sit behind stone tables covered in iron tokens. Every token is a promise, a warning, or a future fight.

room.name: Blackwater Cistern
room.description: A cistern of cold water reflects the ceiling as if it were a drowned city. Compact law marks this place more important than any shrine.

object.name: Cistern Purity Test
object.description: A drip filter has been fouled by black spores and bone-lamp soot.
object.interact_text: You clean the filter, replace the glow-salt, and stop the water from whispering quite so many names.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Wyrmglass Chasm: South Ledge
room.description: The cavern opens into an impossible chasm veined with black glass. Winged things move below the bridge-light like thoughts best left unfinished.

room.name: Echo-Bat Roost
room.description: Thousands of pale bats cling to a ribbed ceiling. Their wings answer even unsaid questions.

room.name: Steps to the Shattered Observatory
room.description: Black stairs climb toward a drow observatory built upside down against the cavern roof, its star windows pointed at stone.

room.name: Shattered Drow Observatory
room.description: A ruined observatory hangs from the cavern ceiling on chains and stubborn geometry. Its lenses study mineral darkness as if it were night sky.

object.name: Inverted Star Chart
object.description: The chart marks the dead star below the horizon, as if the sky has a reflection underground.
object.interact_text: You align the broken lens and see the Astral Citadel’s shadow-road briefly traced in black light.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Inverted Starwell
room.description: A vertical well points upward into stone. Black water clings to the ceiling, reflecting stars that are not there.

object.name: Wyrmglass Lens Alignment
object.description: A cracked mount waits for the Wyrmglass Lens to be set into place.
object.interact_text: You align the lens, and a hidden route to the ossuary glimmers in the chasm glass.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Wyrmglass Bridge
room.description: A narrow bridge of old black glass spans the chasm. It bends under weight but refuses to break, which is somehow worse.

room.name: Suspended Gnomon
room.description: A giant needle of black crystal hangs over the chasm, casting a shadow even without a light source.

object.name: Gnomon Shadow
object.description: The gnomon points toward the Shadowed Ossuary whenever the dead star is not visible.
object.interact_text: You measure the impossible shadow and learn the ossuary is not beneath the chasm. It is inside its reflection.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Wyrmglass Chasm: North Landing
room.description: The far side of the bridge is scored by claw marks and Cabal boot prints. A wind rises from below carrying the smell of old scales.

room.name: Wyrmglass Lower Shelf
room.description: A lower shelf of black glass catches falling echoes. Bones inside the glass look fresh when viewed from the corner of the eye.

room.name: Blackscale Roost
room.description: A cracked alcove holds shed scales, half-melted bones, and scratch marks left by something too large to nest here anymore.

room.name: Approach to the Shadowed Ossuary
room.description: The path narrows into a tunnel lined with fossil ribs. Each rib has been carved into a Cabal chain-anchor and then scratched by something underneath.

room.name: The Shadowed Ossuary Gate
room.description: A gate of bone, crystal, and dragon-scale shadow stands half-open, as if inviting witnesses rather than trespassers.

object.name: Bonechain Inscription
object.description: The inscription describes chains meant to bind a shadow without killing the body that cast it.
object.interact_text: You identify Nhalira’s doctrine: the Cabal intends enslavement, not alliance.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Sun-Mote Outer Cache
room.description: A small cache hides behind a wall that only exists when ignored. The Wyrmglass Lens makes the seam visible.

room.name: Ribbed Hall
room.description: The hall curves through fossil ribs large enough to have belonged to a god, a dragon, or a lie told by both.

room.name: Silent Hammer Cache
room.description: Compact refugees hid tools here behind a stone marked NO CHAINS, NO MASTERS, NO LIGHT WASTED.

room.name: Echoing Catacomb
room.description: Niches hold remains wrapped in black silk. Each step repeats three times: once now, once before, and once as warning.

room.name: Lower Bone Shaft
room.description: A vertical shaft descends through overlapping bones, with handholds carved by people who were fleeing upward.

room.name: Sunken Rib Cache
room.description: Loose ribs form a dead-end chamber where someone hid supplies rather than carry them past the wraiths.

room.name: Ossuary Crossroads
room.description: Four corridors meet beneath a ceiling webbed with black chains. The floor is polished by centuries of things circling rather than leaving.

room.name: Shadowglass Chapel
room.description: A chapel of black reflective crystal honors a version of darkness that shelters rather than devours.

object.name: Shadowglass Prayer
object.description: A prayer asks not for light, but for darkness that keeps the sleeping safe.
object.interact_text: You speak the prayer and the chapel reflects you without the Cabal chains around your shadow.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Wyrmchain Cage
room.description: A vast cage of shadow-chain surrounds nothing visible. Inside it, the air breathes like a sleeping dragon.

object.name: Wyrmchain Anchor
object.description: The anchor is hammered through shadow rather than stone. It binds the Umbralwyrm’s reflection.
object.interact_text: You understand the final choice: kill the wyrm, free it, bind it again, or steal what it guards and run.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Ossuary Underpath
room.description: A crawling passage runs beneath the main ossuary, built for smaller prisoners or clever rescuers.

room.name: Ossuary Sun-Mote Chamber
room.description: A buried point of honest light burns inside a rib cage of crystal. It warms the skin and enrages the shadows.

object.name: Ossuary Sun-Mote Attunement
object.description: A ring of pale rib-crystal waits for the Sun-Mote to be raised into its center.
object.interact_text: You lift the Ossuary Sun-Mote into the rib-crystal ring. Its light learns the shape of the Wyrmchain and can now be used in the final bargain.
object.completed_text: The Sun-Mote has already been attuned to the Wyrmchain.
object.missing_item_text: The rib-crystal remains dark. You need the Ossuary Sun-Mote before this attunement can be completed.

room.name: Blackflame Altar
room.description: A Cabal altar burns with flame that gives no heat and casts light only on chains.

object.name: Blackflame Shutter Latch
object.description: A shutter of negative fire sits in a brass frame etched with command sigils.
object.interact_text: You remove the shutter carefully. It feels like holding a closed eye.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Nhalira’s Ritual Laboratory
room.description: Tables of bone-lamps, chain-glyph drafts, spore-contaminated maps, and dragon-scale scrapings show a methodical plan to weaponize the Depths.

object.name: Nhalira’s Ritual Notes
object.description: The notes connect the Nightscale Lantern to the final citadel’s dead-star shadow roads.
object.interact_text: You learn the Lantern is not a crown fragment; it is a guide through truths the crown cannot illuminate.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Bone-Lamplighter Vault
room.description: Skull-lamps hang from hooks like fruit. Their flames reveal chains inside the shadows of anyone who stands too close.

room.name: Wyrmchain Necromancer’s Circle
room.description: Sister Nhalira Voss stands within a diagram of iron, bone, and captive shadow. The circle pulls at every dark corner in the room.

room.name: Broken Chain Arch
room.description: The passage beyond Nhalira’s circle is an arch of snapped links. Some are metal. Most are shadow. A dragon’s breathing shakes dust from above.

room.name: Bargain Antechamber
room.description: Compact testimony, myconid warnings, and old dragon-scratch marks cover the walls. The chamber teaches that not every monster is the first villain in its own story.

object.name: Terms of the Nightscale Bargain
object.description: The terms define payment, restraint, future debt, and the difference between freeing a power and trusting it.
object.interact_text: You memorize enough of the terms to bargain without sounding like prey.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Binding Control Room
room.description: Cabal control plates surround a shadow well. The controls would let a cruel hand command what it cannot understand.

object.name: Binding Controls
object.description: The controls accept the Blackflame Shutter as a command lens.
object.missing_item_text: The binding frame is empty. It requires the Blackflame Shutter from the altar.
object.interact_text: The controls answer your touch. They will work, which may be the most dangerous thing about them.
object.completed_text: This feature has already yielded its secret.

room.name: Nightscale Reliquary
room.description: The Nightscale Lantern waits on a stone cradle surrounded by scales the size of shields. It is not lit, but every shadow leans toward it.

room.name: Wyrmheart Cavern
room.description: The deepest cavern beats with a slow mineral pulse. The Nightscale Lantern reveals a crown-shaped wound in the northern wall, but the path through it is not merely another tunnel; it is the last breath before stars and the road that will not open twice.

companion_dialogue.line: Down here, silence does not mean safety. It means the thing listening is patient.
The Depths are not a dungeon. They are a country without a sky.

room.name: The Last Breath Before Stars
room.description: The Wyrmheart Cavern narrows into a black-glass alcove where the Nightscale Lantern throws no light except on the crown-shaped gate. Supplies, companions, and unfinished errands belong behind you. Beyond the gate is the Astral Crown Citadel, and the road will close after entry.

object.name: Black-Star Crown Gate
object.description: A gate shaped like a crown wound hangs in the stone. The Nightscale Lantern reveals the Citadel beyond it, already forcing itself toward the Aurelian Marches.
object.missing_item_text: The gate remains only a bruise in the stone. The Nightscale Lantern is required to see and open it.
object.interact_text: You raise the Nightscale Lantern. The gate opens without sound, and the Citadel waits beyond the last safe breath of the world.
object.completed_text: The Black-Star Crown Gate is open. Passing north begins the final lockout sequence.

companion_dialogue.line: No road song knows this next step.
The gate is not asking whether we are ready. It is asking whether we will go.

room.name: Citadel Threshold of Falling Seals
room.description: The gate drops you onto white-black masonry under a dead star. Behind you, Wyrmheart darkness folds shut; ahead, the Astral Crown Citadel cracks through planar seals and strains toward material form above the Marches.
room.sealed_message: The Black-Star Crown Gate seals behind you. Wyrmheart Cavern, the Depths, and the rest of the Marches are now memory until the Citadel is resolved.

companion_dialogue.line: The way back is a memory, not an exit.
The Citadel is arriving. We have to make sure it arrives nowhere.

room.name: Refuge of Broken Chains
room.description: A desperate outpost fills a broken reliquary just past the Citadel entrance. Halfling cooks, lizardfolk healers, dwarven smiths, fey exiles, Blue Veil researchers, storm-servitors, deep folk, and ordinary prisoners hold the last living settlement behind barricades of stolen shields.

companion_dialogue.line: Every people we helped has an echo here.
This is not a camp. It is a refusal to be erased.

room.name: Makeshift Infirmary
room.description: Flooded pews, giant bandages, mushroom poultices, and river-clay basins form a battlefield infirmary. No one here asks what faction a patient belonged to before the Cabal put chains on them.

room.name: Crate-Market of the Lost
room.description: Stolen crates from every zone have been re-sorted into a market of necessities. Labels from Terrecester, Vandarom, Applewallow, Onfadell, and Hawga Daar overlap on the same desperate shelves.

room.name: War Table of the Unclaimed
room.description: A shattered angelic table is covered in bone maps, mirage equations, tide knots, storm runes, and refugee reports. No crown commands this room; necessity does.

object.name: Refuge War Table
object.description: Every road of the Marches is represented by some stolen object or survivor testimony.
object.interact_text: You review the Refuge defenses, the Citadel gates, and the order of relic seals needed to reach the Crownless Throne.
object.completed_text: The war table has already given you the final plan.

room.name: Barricade of Stolen Shields
room.description: Shields from a dozen conquered peoples form the outer barricade. Cabal troops test the line constantly, hoping to recapture the escaped before they become an army.

room.name: Left Breach Flank
room.description: A side breach looks over a drop full of broken planar roads. Harriers try to climb it whenever the dead star pulses.

room.name: Right Breach Flank
room.description: A half-collapsed chapel holds barricade ropes, spare arrows, and a Cabal battering head still smoking from the last assault.

room.name: Cabal Breach Stair
room.description: A staircase made from mismatched prison doors climbs out of the Refuge. Each step is engraved with a different prisoner number, many crossed out by refugee knives.

room.name: Hall of Unfinished Materialization
room.description: Walls phase between citadel stone and Aurelian soil. In some cracks you can see fields, wharves, mines, and mountain ledges the Citadel intends to occupy.

room.name: Planar Chain Gallery
room.description: Vast chains hang from nowhere, each link hooked into a different half-arrived corridor. Some links still bear the marks of dwarven forced labor.

room.name: Astral Masonry Yard
room.description: Unfinished blocks drift in low gravity while captured masons’ tools hammer by themselves. Refuge marks show where someone hid stabilizers before escaping.

room.name: Room of Falling Roads
room.description: Roads from earlier zones fall through the ceiling as ghostly bridges, then vanish before touching the floor. The Citadel is testing which route into the Marches will hold.

room.name: Suspended Road Cache
room.description: A fragment of road hangs in the air, loaded with supplies tied there by someone who knew gravity would eventually become negotiable.

room.name: Cabal Siege Post
room.description: A siege post faces back toward the Refuge. The Cabal does not need to win every assault; it only needs the living to stop resting.

room.name: Crownworks Rampart
room.description: A rampart overlooks a sky where the Aurelian Marches flicker below like a map being burned into reality.

room.name: Seal Gate of Survival
room.description: Two enormous sockets hold the first progression gate. One is storm-carved, one pearl-lined. The Citadel cannot be entered by ambition alone; it must first be forced not to kill the living behind you.

object.name: Thunderheart Aegis Socket
object.description: A storm-giant socket waits for the Thunderheart Aegis.
object.missing_item_text: The socket waits for the Thunderheart Aegis of Thundervale Peaks.
object.interact_text: You set the Thunderheart Aegis into the storm socket. The gate learns restraint before power.
object.completed_text: The storm socket already holds steady weather inside the broken Citadel.

object.name: Tidecrown Pearl Socket
object.description: A pearl-lined basin waits for the Tidecrown Pearl of Glendes.
object.missing_item_text: The basin waits for the Tidecrown Pearl, after the storm socket is woken.
object.interact_text: You lower the Tidecrown Pearl into the basin. Water, storm, and breath stabilize the Refuge approach, opening the path north.
object.completed_text: The Seal of Survival is open, and the Refuge holds behind you.

room.name: Survival Seal Cache
room.description: The opened Seal of Survival exposes a cache of field supplies gathered by those who expected a final march to require practical mercy.

room.name: The Concordance Halls
room.description: The next wing twists earlier histories into accusations: shared fields, fey names, free craft, and drowned oaths all rewritten as Cabal property. The relics must answer in their own voices.

room.name: Hall of Barrow Oaths
room.description: Long tables are set for harvest feasts no one attended. Every empty chair accuses the Lich of mistaking shared bread for weakness.

room.name: Thorn-Mirror Court
room.description: Mirrors made of living thorn reflect the name you would have had if fear had raised you instead of kindness.

room.name: Sun-Iron Judgment Forge
room.description: A stolen Dawnhammer forge has been forced to stamp identical weapons for identical soldiers. Its anvil shakes whenever free craft is remembered nearby.

room.name: Drowned King’s Witness
room.description: Water fills the lower chamber without spilling upward. A drowned stone king watches silently as the Citadel repeats every old mistake about rule without duty.

room.name: Cabal Interrogatory
room.description: This chamber was built to extract allegiance from people who refused to be renamed. Scratched marks on the floor point toward the stolen archive.

room.name: Archive of Stolen Names
room.description: Shelves of name-strips, craft-marks, brood-oaths, and field ledgers burn with cold fire. The Citadel tried to own identity before owning land.

room.name: Seal Gate of Memory
room.description: Four smaller seals wait in sequence: seed, thorn, forge, and drowned band. The door will not open for relics alone; it opens because each relic proves a people remembered itself.

object.name: Shared Seed Seal
object.description: A clay-green seal shaped like a shared seed waits for Greenbarrow’s relic.
object.missing_item_text: The Shared Seed of Greenbarrow is required.
object.interact_text: You press the Shared Seed to the seal. Empty chairs fill with the memory of meals freely given.
object.completed_text: The seed seal is already warm with remembered hospitality.

object.name: Crownroot Thorn Seal
object.description: A thorned mirror-seal waits for Onfadell’s old magic.
object.missing_item_text: The Crownroot Thorn Sigil is required after the seed seal wakes.
object.interact_text: You raise the Crownroot Thorn Sigil. Stolen names crawl back through the mirrors and refuse the Cabal alphabet.
object.completed_text: The thorn seal is already alive with returned names.

object.name: Dawn-Forge Seal
object.description: A sun-iron gear waits for the Dawn-Forge Keystone.
object.missing_item_text: The Dawn-Forge Keystone is required after the thorn seal wakes.
object.interact_text: You fit the Keystone into the gear. The forge remembers craft as choice, not compulsion.
object.completed_text: The forge seal already turns freely.

object.name: Drowned Band Seal
object.description: A drowned circlet waits for the marsh relic and the truth of lost kingship.
object.missing_item_text: The Drowned Band is required after the forge seal wakes.
object.interact_text: You set the Drowned Band into the final socket. The dead kingdom bears witness, and the Gate of Memory opens.
object.completed_text: The Seal of Memory is open.

room.name: Memory Seal Cache
room.description: Behind the opened memory gate waits a small chamber of returned names and reclaimed tools.

room.name: Starless Reliquary Entry
room.description: The Citadel’s navigation heart begins here. Rooms no longer ask where they are; they ask where they intend to be.

room.name: Mirage Alignment Chamber
room.description: Three invisible roads cross through a lens of desert glass. The Blue Veil would call it beautiful after calling it dangerous.

room.name: Pearl-Tide Observatory
room.description: A sea without water moves overhead, plotting every possible coastline where the Citadel might fall into the Marches.

room.name: Thunderheart Conduit
room.description: Storm channels thunder through a corridor too tall for mortal architecture. The conduit answers the Aegis with clean lightning instead of corpse-light.

room.name: Dead-Star Orrery
room.description: A black orrery turns above a pit, computing the moment the Citadel will become a fortress in the Aurelian Marches unless redirected.

room.name: Seal Gate of Direction
room.description: Three directional seals form a map with no north: mirage road, tide horizon, and storm height. Align them or the Citadel will choose the Marches as its landing place.

object.name: Mirage Road Seal
object.description: A desert-glass seal bends every path into three false roads.
object.missing_item_text: The Glasswind relic is required.
object.interact_text: You align the Glasswind relic. False roads become measurable error instead of command.
object.completed_text: The mirage seal is already aligned.

object.name: Tide Horizon Seal
object.description: A pearl horizon turns in a circle with no shore.
object.missing_item_text: The Tidecrown Pearl is required after the mirage seal wakes.
object.interact_text: You set the Tidecrown Pearl at the horizon point. The Citadel loses its claim on the Thesmeda Sea.
object.completed_text: The tide seal already holds its true horizon.

object.name: Storm Height Seal
object.description: A storm-height socket waits for the Thunderheart Aegis.
object.missing_item_text: The Thunderheart Aegis is required after the tide seal wakes.
object.interact_text: You lift the Aegis into the storm-height socket. The Citadel is redirected away from the Marches, opening the inner road.
object.completed_text: The Seal of Direction is open.

room.name: Reliquary of Wrong Horizons
room.description: Every window shows a different place the Citadel tried to invade. One shows Hearthwatch. One shows your own shadow arriving before you.

room.name: Astral Collapse Bridge
room.description: A bridge of falling geometry crosses nothing. The Refuge marked the safest sequence with chalk, then crossed out half the marks after the bridge changed its mind.

room.name: The Lich’s Processional
room.description: A final avenue leads inward between statues of rulers with their faces removed. The path does not celebrate kingship; it celebrates obedience.

room.name: Crownless Choir Nave
room.description: Rows of undead singers rehearse the coronation hymn for a throne no living people accepted.

room.name: The Unbreathing Armory
room.description: Weapons stand ready in racks that inhale when touched. Many were forged by prisoners who sabotaged one rivet per blade.

room.name: Reliquary of Failed Crowns
room.description: Broken crowns orbit a black lectern. Each failed crown once promised order without humility, safety without consent, or law without mercy.

object.name: Crown-Rite Lectern
object.description: A lectern explains how to force a tyrant to kneel by using the language of tyranny against itself.
object.missing_item_text: The Crown-Rite Sigil must be taken before the lectern can be read.
object.interact_text: You study the rite and understand how to raise the sigil against the Crownless Lich. The knowledge is useful and unpleasant.
object.completed_text: The Crown-Rite has already been mastered.

room.name: Prison of Unfinished Bodies
room.description: Prisoners half-phased from failed planar transport hang in mercy wards. The Refuge has marked who can still be saved and who must not be moved.

room.name: Nightscale Shadow Alcove
room.description: The Nightscale Lantern reveals an alcove of honest darkness. The Umbralwyrm’s shadow does not enter the Citadel; it waits at the edge and watches.

object.name: Nightscale Shadow Oath
object.description: The alcove accepts only the Nightscale Lantern and a promise that some powers are safer hidden than crowned.
object.missing_item_text: The Nightscale Lantern is required to invoke the shadow oath.
object.interact_text: You lift the Lantern and the darkness answers, offering one possible future for the Astral Crown.
object.completed_text: The Nightscale Shadow has already heard your oath.

room.name: Black-Star Door
room.description: A door made from absence bars the final throne. The Nightscale Lantern does not open it by shining; it opens it by proving which darkness is false.

object.name: Black-Star Door Ward
object.description: A crown-shaped absence waits for the Nightscale Lantern and the completed directional seals.
object.missing_item_text: The Nightscale Lantern and opened directional seals are required.
object.interact_text: You raise the Nightscale Lantern. The false darkness peels away, revealing the final passage to the Crownless Throne.
object.completed_text: The Black-Star Door is open.

room.name: Throne Antechamber
room.description: The last chamber before the throne contains no guards, only mirrors showing every place that would kneel if the Lich wins.

room.name: The Crownless Throne
room.description: The throne room is a wound shaped like authority. The incomplete Astral Crown hangs above a seat the Lich cannot truly occupy, because no living people gave it to him.

room.name: The Astral Crown Reassembled
room.description: The final chamber is quiet after impossible noise. The Astral Crown waits in pieces of light, law, grief, craft, tide, storm, shadow, and choice. The next command is not movement; it is an ending.

companion_dialogue.line: Power is waiting for an excuse.
Choose carefully. Every road behind us will have to live with it.
